title: Flight log label
description: What a log in the test corpus is and what it should show. SITL fixtures carry one beside each log in tests/fixtures/; real fleet logs use the same format, kept with the logs outside the repository. Labels never hold positions, place names or identifiers.

source.description: Simulator run or a real aircraft of the fleet

archetype.description: Archetype an engineer assigned (spec: Vehicle fingerprinting), e.g. 'heavy-lift with variable payload'

scenario.description: SITL scenario name, or a short name for the flight

parameters_set.description: Parameters set on purpose for this log, beyond the defaults

faults.description: Faults injected (SITL) or known to be present (fleet)

expected.description: What an engineer expects the log to show; analyzer golden tests check against these

fixes.description: Fleet logs: what fixed the known problems
